examples.text: If you think you have seen almost everything in this world, you've got to see this museum. (Spanish - European, B2 VANTAGE, Pass, 1998)
[talking about a famous actor] You have to see at least one of her films … I think if you haven't seen her films, you haven't lived at all! (Spanish - Other, B2 VANTAGE, Pass, 2006)
You have to relax. You should try to live. You don't know what's going on around you. (Switzerland; B2 VANTAGE; 1993; German; Pass)
The main thing to remember is that there many possibilities but you have to try to find them and not just say: "I want to work and earn money". (Switzerland; B2 VANTAGE; 2000; French; Pass)
You needn't worry about where we can stay. (China; B2 VANTAGE; 1998; Chinese; Pass)
… when I send an e-mail, I need not worry about the time. (Japan; B2 VANTAGE; 2000; Japanese; Pass)
You needn't go out jogging in the evening because you have already had your exercise. (Sweden; B2 VANTAGE; 1993; Swedish; Pass)
I like summer so much because the weather is hot and we needn't wear a jacket. (Greece; B2 VANTAGE; 2000; Greek; Pass)
[talking about preparing for a party] As for the music, you needn't worry about it. (Greece; B2 VANTAGE; 2009; Greek; Pass)
Otherwise some students would not get as much specialised help as they ought to. (Germany; B2 VANTAGE; 2010; German; Pass)
Furthermore, we ought to take care of our health by going on trips to not unpolluted places as often as possible. (France; B2 VANTAGE; 1999; French; Pass)

Of course not all zoos are as good as they ought to be, but today we know so much about the different animals that they don't have to get bored in the zoo and we're able to provide them with the environment they prefer. (Denmark; B2 VANTAGE; 1993; Danish; Pass)
There shouldn't be any rubbish dumps, all the rubbish ought to be recycled. (Brazil; B2 VANTAGE; 1993; Portuguese; Pass)
She doesn't travel as much as she used to. (Argentina; B2 VANTAGE; 1999; Spanish - Latin American; Pass)
I must admit that they did sound quite a lot better than they used to. (Denmark; B2 VANTAGE; 1999; Danish; Pass)
Will you please send me his name, address and telephone number. (Sweden; B2 VANTAGE; 1993; Swedish; Pass)
Will you please inform me about the exact payment. (Netherlands; B2 VANTAGE; 1998; Dutch; Pass)
Will you pay attention! (Hungary; B2 VANTAGE; 2005; Hungarian; Pass)
[talking about a job that the speaker did last year] In my opinion I worked very hard. I would spend a lot of hours at work. (Chinese, B2 VANTAGE, Pass, 2011)
[from a story about pirates] At night they would go to the rocky seaside and light a fire in order to deceive the boats and let them crash on the rocks. (Portuguese, B2 VANTAGE, Pass, 1993)
